scenarios.title: A card with disturb can be cast transformed from the graveyard for its disturb cost
decisions: A casts Mourning Patrol from the graveyard transformed using disturb, paying {3}{W} with four Plains.

variants.label: disturb_cost
variants.expected: The cast is legal. Mourning Patrol moves from the graveyard to the stack and A taps four Plains.

variants.label: front_face
variants.delta: A tries to cast Mourning Patrol front face up from the graveyard for its mana cost {2}{W}.
variants.expected: The cast is not legal: a card in the graveyard can be cast only through disturb. Mourning Patrol stays in the graveyard and no Plains are tapped.

variants.label: one_land_short
variants.expected: The disturb cast is not legal because {3}{W} cannot be paid. Mourning Patrol stays in the graveyard.

scenarios.title: A spell cast with disturb enters the battlefield with its back face up
decisions: A casts the Mourning Patrol in the graveyard transformed using disturb, paying {3}{W} with four Plains.
Both players pass; the spell resolves.

variants.label: disturb
variants.expected: The spell resolves and enters the battlefield back face up as Morning Apparition, a 2/1 white Spirit Soldier with flying and vigilance.

variants.label: cast_from_hand
variants.delta: A casts the Mourning Patrol in hand front face up for its mana cost {2}{W} instead.
variants.expected: The spell resolves and enters the battlefield front face up as Mourning Patrol, a 2/3 white Human Soldier with vigilance.
